description_en: 🚀 The fast, Pythonic way to build MCP servers and clients.
readme_excerpt: FastMCP 🚀 Move fast and make things. Made with 💙 by Prefect The Model Context Protocol (MCP) connects LLMs to tools and data. FastMCP is a full MCP application framework for servers, clients, and interactive apps. A server starts with ordinary Python: Why FastMCP Building an effective MCP application is harder than it looks. FastMCP handles all of it.
